violations.message: J1 and J2 pads sit inside the dashed mounting-hole courtyards at the bottom-left and bottom-right corners, and C5/C6 are placed nearly touching with overlapping outlines in the 2D view.

J1's screw terminal opening faces outward at the edge, but J2 is jammed onto the bottom-right mounting hole (screw head blocks cable/screwdriver access) and J3 is a vertical header set inboard of the right edge rather than opening outward at it.

The main power chain is roughly in one row, but C4/C5/C6/J3 form a scattered diagonal cluster at the upper right and D1/R1/R2 are stacked irregularly, so components do not form clean aligned rows/columns.
Reference designators visibly collide: the U1 text is garbled by an overlapping label, D1/R1/R2 texts stack on each other, C5/C6 overlap, and the C4 label sits on its own pad.
Roughly the entire upper-left half of the board is empty while all components are congested in a band along the bottom and right, indicating heavily disproportionate area usage.
C4 is within ~2mm of U2, but the +3V3 decoupling pair C5/C6 sits ~8mm from U2 and the +5V rail cap C2 is ~10mm from the L1/buck output, far beyond the few-mm adjacency requirement.

In 3d_top two bare two-pad footprints below D1 (R1/R2 per the 2D view) have no component bodies at all, so body-centered-on-pads cannot be confirmed for them; all other visible bodies are centered on their pads.

The buck chain along the bottom reads as an ordered row, but the LDO cluster is scattered: C4 floats several mm above U2, C5/C6 are offset rather than grid-aligned with U2, and long ratsnest lines fan out to J3, so the group does not read as a tight aligned cluster.

The chain doubles back: flow runs right to L1 and C2 (+5V node), then jumps back left and far up to U2/C4 before returning right and down to C5/C6/J2/J3, so the regulator subgroup does not read in signal order.

Zoomed 3d_top shows the two two-pad footprints below D1 (R1/R2 per the 2D refs) are bare pads with no component bodies at all, so body-on-pad placement cannot be confirmed for them; all other bodies are centered on their footprints.

The buck chain reads as an ordered bottom row, but the regulator group is scattered with no grid alignment (C4 floats well above U2, C5/C6 offset diagonally right, C2 hangs below, J3 stranded toward the corner) and the entire upper half of the board is dead space.
